description: Read a Discord channel's recent messages, newest first, for context — what members are saying before you write. Other people’s text needs Discord’s Message Content intent; a message Discord withholds is marked contentHidden. member reads the bot’s direct messages with that person instead (answer with send_discord_dm); mentions:true reads what people said TO the bot (messages that mention it or reply to its posts) in the busiest channels. Free.

before.description: page back from this message id

brand.description: WHICH PROFILE the post lives in — id or exact name from list_brands (a shared workspace: its profile id). Needed when it was published in a profile this connection is not pinned to; applies to THIS CALL ONLY. A name that matches no profile, or two, is REFUSED and nothing is done.

channel.description: channel id or #name; unset = the default channel

member.description: a member id (search_discord_members): read the bot’s DM with them

mentions.description: true = only what people said to the bot

name: read_discord_channel
title: Read a Discord channel
